title: The 24-hour rule
hook: Setty, on his two road cases in a green-screen studio, to the coach on his apple box: You've got ten thousand [bleep]ing contacts in Manychat, right?
biais: écart de curiosité (« this is why »)
aversion à la perte (les contacts de mars hors d'atteinte)
cta: Comment SETTY (he sends everything to build your AI setter for free)
caption:
Comment "SETTY" and he'll send you everything to build a free AI setter that works inside Meta's 24-hour window. Follow so the DM lands 📩

👇 READ BELOW: why you can't just message your 10,000 Manychat contacts, from Meta's and Manychat's own docs.

1. When a lead messages you on Instagram or Messenger, a 24-hour window opens, and every new message from them restarts it.

2. Inside the window you can reply freely, even with an offer. After it, automated messages aren't allowed, and Manychat won't send your scheduled ones.

3. For 7 more days a person can still reply by hand (Meta calls it the Human Agent tag), and message tags can't carry promotions.

4. Setty is the AI setter I built for coaches: he answers once the lead is done typing, then sends up to 3 follow-ups, all inside the 24 hours, through Manychat.

The catch: ManySetter doesn't bend Meta's rules. Once the window closes, Setty waits until the lead writes again. Building and testing are free with no card, then going live starts a 14-day trial at $119/month per live setter.

Comment "SETTY" and he'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
